text:
sandeep: heads up - we're seeing ~30-40% packet loss between pods in the gpu-pool when talking east-west (same cluster, different AZs). affecting inference throughput on dedicated tenants :frowning:

maria: ack. which namespaces? any recent policy changes?

sandeep: mainly ml-inference -> feature-tests namespaces. noticed after a config push around 09:10 UTC. infra-bot alerted on increased retransmits.

infra-bot: alert: packet_loss_detected namespace=ml-inference src_pod=encoder-0 dest_pod=kv-cache-2 loss=32% time=2025-07-02T09:18:03Z

kai: can you paste `kubectl get netpol -n ml-inference` and `-n feature-tests`? also tcpdump from one of the source pods would help.

sandeep: running quick dumps:

```
$ kubectl -n ml-inference get networkpolicy
NAME                 POD-SELECTOR   AGE
deny-egress-all      app:inference  2h
allow-monitoring     app:ops        3d
```

`deny-egress-all` looks suspicious.

maria: omg that deny-everything policy was intended to lock down internet egress for that namespace, not east-west inside the cluster. looks like we applied a policy with `to: {}` instead of restricting to CIDR for 0.0.0.0/0 egress.

kai: can you describe it?

sandeep: `kubectl -n ml-inference describe networkpolicy deny-egress-all` -> shows `egress: - to: []` which equates to deny all egress for selected pods.

maria: yeah that will block clusterIP and headless service traffic if there's no explicit allow. RIP KV cache reachability.

oncall-ops: i'm putting the GPU tenant scaling on hold. see elevated 503s to model servers.

sandeep: tcpdump from encoder pod shows SYNs leaving but no ACKs from kv-cache across AZ boundary. MTU looks fine locally, but packet gets dropped somewhere mid-path.

kai: any calico/felix logs? maybe a policy-programming bug interacting with hostEndpoints or hostNetwork pods.

sandeep: checking calico-node logs on node-gpu-02: `msg=Policy allowed 0px denied 1px` around 09:12. also saw `Error applying policy: invalid egress rule` earlier.

maria: quick mitigation: we should add a narrow egress allow for cluster-internal traffic while we triage. i'm going to apply a temporary policy to allow namespaceSelector: feature-tests and clusterCIDR.

sandeep: paste applied:

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-eastwest-cluster
  namespace: ml-inference
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inference
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          net-safe: "true"
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/8
```

infra-bot: config_apply: networkpolicy/allow-eastwest-cluster applied by maria at 2025-07-02T09:26:10Z

sandeep: immediate drop in retransmits to <2% after apply. throughput recovered for the GPU workloads.

kai: long-term fix: update the original deny policy to use `to: ipBlock` for internet, or use an explicit allow list for cross-namespace services. also add e2e tests for netpol to catch this during PR CI.

maria: filing PR to change deny-egress-all -> deny-internet-only and adding namespaceSelector exceptions. I'll include a cilium/calico note depending on runtime.

oncall-ops: pls add a postmortem blurb to incidents with timeline and the emergency patch hash. also tag tenant owners for impacted customers.

sandeep: thanks all. leaving the temp allow in place for now until PR merges and we can roll out safely.

maria: follow-up: audit log shows `kubectl apply -f deny-egress-all.yaml` by infra-automation at 09:08. will open a ticket to make the automation generate the correct ipBlock-based rule.

kai: add unit test in infra-config repo to flag `egress: - to: []` in any netpols.

sandeep: noted. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: incident: resolved - performance regression mitigated by temporary policy allow. created incident ID: INF-2025-57
